enroll.title: Add a person
enroll.description:
Record each line as a separate WAV. Use your normal speaking voice and aim for 4–8 seconds of clear speech per file. Keep other voices and the TV out of the recording. The words are examples, so you can also use your own sentences.

1. “{sample_one}”
2. “{sample_two}”
3. “{sample_three}”

data.name: Display name
data.consent: This person agreed to enroll their voice

delete.title: Delete a voice profile
delete.description: Choose the profile to remove. This removes its template from the live integration.

data.confirm: I confirm removal of the selected person's profile

profiles.title: Voice profiles
profiles.description: {count} people enrolled. Create one profile per person.

retrain.title: Replace a person's samples
retrain.description:
Choose a person and make three fresh recordings. Saving them keeps the same speaker ID.

Record each line as a separate WAV. Use your normal speaking voice and aim for 4–8 seconds of clear speech per file. Keep other voices and the TV out of the recording. The words are examples, so you can also use your own sentences.

1. “{sample_one}”
2. “{sample_two}”
3. “{sample_three}”

data.consent: This person agreed to enroll their voice

rename.title: Rename a profile
rename.description: Update the display name. The person keeps the same speaker ID and voice template.

test.title: Test a recording
test.description: Use a fresh WAV recording that was not used for enrollment. Choose the expected person or Unknown speaker to get a pass or fail. This test runs locally and does not trigger Sentient or automations.

satellite.title: Record from a speaker
satellite.description: Use the speaker you actually talk to, so the voice profile matches how it hears you. Enter the person's name (an existing name replaces that person's samples). For the next 10 minutes, the next three long sentences spoken to a Voice Recognition speaker are used as the samples instead of being run as commands; the speaker tells you what to say next.

error.profile_limit: The maximum of 16 voice profiles is already enrolled.
error.bad_samples: Upload three distinct PCM WAV files with clear speech from the same person. Use 16-bit mono or stereo audio, 8–48 kHz, and files of at most 20 seconds. Please reselect all three files.
error.profile_missing: The selected profile has already been removed.
error.storage_error: Home Assistant could not save the change. Check storage and try again.
error.invalid_token: Use the same token configured in the engine app. It must contain 24–128 letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores.
error.engine_unavailable: Check that Sentient Voice Engine is running, that its token matches and that the installation type is correct. Reselect any recording before retrying.
error.confirm_delete: Confirm that you want to delete this voice profile.
error.duplicate_voice: These samples closely match another profile. Check the person you selected and use fresh recordings before trying again.
error.bad_test_sample: Select a fresh 16-bit PCM WAV with clear speech from one person, up to 20 seconds. Then try again.
error.engine_busy: Voice Engine is busy. Wait for the current request to finish, then select your recording again.
error.no_profiles: Enroll a person before testing a recording.
error.integration_reloaded: Voice Recognition was reloaded. Reopen Configure and try again.
error.sample_unreadable: This upload could not be read. Choose a nonempty WAV recording and reselect all three files.
error.sample_duplicate: This sounds like a recording you already selected. Record a new take and reselect all three files.

error.samples_inconsistent: The three recordings sound too different. Record the same person speaking alone at a similar distance from the microphone, then select three fresh files.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is still loading. Try again when setup is complete.
abort.profile_retrained: The profile was updated with the new samples.
abort.open_recorder: [Open the microphone recorder]({recorder_path}). Use Home Assistant over HTTPS, then allow microphone access when asked.
abort.satellite_started: Ready for {name}. Go to the speaker you want to use, say its wake word, and read this out loud: “{sentence}”. It will give you the next two sentences. Anyone else speaking to a Voice Recognition speaker in the next 10 minutes would be taken as a sample, so keep the room quiet.

start_speaker_enrolment.name: Record a voice from a speaker
start_speaker_enrolment.description: Opens a ten-minute window: the next three sentences spoken to a Voice Recognition speaker become this person's voice profile. Returns the first sentence to read.

name.name: Name
name.description: Who is recording. An existing name replaces that person's samples.

cancel_speaker_enrolment.name: Cancel recording from a speaker
cancel_speaker_enrolment.description: Closes an open recording window without saving anything.

status.name: Voice recognition status
status.description: Reports whether the voice engine is reachable, each saved voice and how close the nearest other voice is, and the match level.

set_match_threshold.name: Set the match level
set_match_threshold.description: Changes how similar a voice must be to be matched (0.50 to 0.90). Lower matches more easily but risks a wrong name.
